description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — WSTG-04-06 Authn/Authz/Session supplement (brute force, MFA bypass, session hijacking, JWT, OAuth, privilege escalation, IDOR, API key exposure, CORS/CSRF, password policy)

rules.name: Slow Brute Force - Distributed Password Spraying
rules.description: Detects low-and-slow password spraying across multiple IPs targeting a single account over 24h
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Password Spraying Against VPN Gateway
rules.description: Detects password spraying attacks against VPN concentrators using rotating usernames
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("vpn" OR "openvpn" OR "ipsec") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Credential Stuffing - High Velocity Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing using automated tools with rapid login attempts across multiple accounts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND http.user_agent:("python-requests" OR "curl" OR "httpclient" OR "自动化" OR "masscan")

rules.name: Credential Stuffing - Valid Account Takeover
rules.description: Detects successful logins immediately following multiple failed attempts from same source indicating credential stuffing success
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND source.ip:* AND _exists_:source.ip

rules.name: Brute Force Against SSH Service
rules.description: Detects SSH brute force attempts with high failure rate from single source
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:"sshd" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against RDP Service
rules.description: Detects RDP brute force login attempts from single source IP
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("rdp" OR "xrdp" OR "microsoft-windows-terminalservices") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against LDAP Directory
rules.description: Detects LDAP bind failures indicating brute force attacks against directory services
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("ldap" OR "openldap" OR "389ds") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Distributed Brute Force - Botnet Login Attempts
rules.description: Detects coordinated login failures from many IPs targeting single account indicating botnet-driven brute force
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND user.name:*

rules.name: Brute Force Against FTP Service
rules.description: Detects FTP login brute force attempts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("ftp" OR "vsftpd" OR "proftpd" OR "pure-ftpd") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against Database Login
rules.description: Detects database authentication brute force including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure" AND service.name:("mysql" OR "postgresql" OR "mssql" OR "oracle")

rules.name: Password Spraying Against Cloud IAM
rules.description: Detects password spraying targeting AWS IAM, Azure AD, or GCP IAM login endpoints
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND cloud.provider:("aws" OR "azure" OR "gcp") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against Kerberos
rules.description: Detects Kerberos pre-authentication failures indicating brute force or Kerberoasting
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:"kerberos" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against API Authentication Endpoint
rules.description: Detects automated brute force attacks against REST API login endpoints
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/api/v*/auth" OR "/api/v*/login" OR "/api/v*/token") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Slow Brute Force - Low Frequency Over Extended Period
rules.description: Detects low-frequency login failures over 7-day window designed to evade rate limiting
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against SAML IdP
rules.description: Detects brute force login attempts against SAML Identity Provider endpoints
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("saml" OR "shibboleth" OR "keycloak") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against OAuth Token Endpoint
rules.description: Detects repeated failed OAuth token acquisition attempts
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/oauth/token" OR "/oauth2/token" OR "/token") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Credential Stuffing - Proxy Rotation Detection
rules.description: Detects credential stuffing using rotating proxy IPs identified by varied user agents and ASN clusters
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against Mail Server
rules.description: Detects IMAP/POP3/SMTP authentication brute force
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("imap" OR "pop3" OR "smtp" OR "dovecot" OR "postfix") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Password Spraying Against SaaS Applications
rules.description: Detects password spraying attacks targeting SaaS application login pages
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("office365" OR "gsuite" OR "salesforce" OR "slack" OR "zoom") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: Brute Force Against WordPress Login
rules.description: Detects brute force attacks against WordPress wp-login.php endpoint
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:"/wp-login.php" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: MFA Bypass - Direct MFA Reset Request Without Secondary Verification
rules.description: Detects MFA reset requests without proper secondary identity verification
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("mfa-reset" OR "mfa-disable" OR "mfa-remove") AND NOT event.action:"mfa-verify"

rules.name: MFA Fatigue Attack - Repeated Push Notifications
rules.description: Detects MFA push notification fatigue attacks with excessive push notifications to single user
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-push" AND event.outcome:"denied"

rules.name: MFA Bypass - Authentication Without MFA Step
rules.description: Detects successful authentication events where MFA step was skipped or bypassed
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT _exists_:"mfa_method"

rules.name: MFA Downgrade - TOTP to SMS Fallback Abuse
rules.description: Detects suspicious downgrade from TOTP to SMS-based MFA which is more vulnerable to SIM swapping
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-downgrade" AND mfa.method:(("sms") AND (NOT "totp"))

rules.name: SIM Swap Preceding MFA Bypass
rules.description: Detects SIM swap events followed by MFA authentication suggesting SIM swap MFA bypass
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"sim-swap"

rules.name: MFA Bypass via Backup Code Usage
rules.description: Detects excessive use of MFA backup/recovery codes instead of primary MFA method
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND mfa.method:"backup-code"

rules.name: MFA Token Replay Attack
rules.description: Detects reuse of MFA tokens across multiple sessions or from different locations
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND mfa.token_id:* AND event.outcome:"success"

rules.name: MFA Enrollment by Recently Compromised Account
rules.description: Detects MFA enrollment activity on accounts that recently had suspicious login activity
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"mfa-enroll" AND user.name:*

rules.name: MFA Bypass via Legacy Protocol
rules.description: Detects authentication via legacy protocols that bypass MFA requirements (POP3, IMAP, SMTP Auth, ActiveSync)
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND service.name:("pop3" OR "imap" OR "smtp-auth" OR "activesync" OR "ews-basic") AND event.outcome:"success"

rules.name: MFA Device Registration From Anomalous Location
rules.description: Detects MFA device registration from IP geolocation inconsistent with user baseline
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("mfa-device-register" OR "mfa-device-add") AND source.geo.country_name:*

rules.name: Repeated MFA Verification Failures
rules.description: Detects multiple failed MFA verification attempts suggesting brute force of MFA codes
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"mfa-verify" AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: MFA Provider Configuration Change
rules.description: Detects changes to MFA provider configuration that could weaken authentication requirements
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("mfa-config-change" OR "mfa-policy-update") AND NOT user.name:("admin-service" OR "system")

rules.name: MFA Bypass via OAuth Device Code Flow
rules.description: Detects OAuth device code flow authentication that bypasses MFA requirements
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND oauth.grant_type:"urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code" AND event.outcome:"success"

rules.name: MFA Trusted IP Bypass Abuse
rules.description: Detects authentication success from trusted IP ranges that bypass MFA where the IP may be spoofed or compromised
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND mfa.bypassed:true AND source.ip:*

rules.name: MFA Recovery Process Abuse
rules.description: Detects MFA account recovery attempts that could bypass MFA security controls
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("account-recovery" OR "mfa-recovery") AND NOT user.name:("admin-service")

rules.name: Session Fixation - Session ID Not Rotated After Login
rules.description: Detects authentication events where session ID remains unchanged before and after login
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"login" AND event.outcome:"success" AND session.id:*

rules.name: Session Hijacking - Concurrent Sessions From Different Locations
rules.description: Detects same session active from two geographically distant locations simultaneously
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"session-active" AND session.id:* AND source.geo.*:*

rules.name: Session Token Theft - Session Used After Logout
rules.description: Detects requests using session tokens after the session was explicitly terminated
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"request" AND session.id:* AND session.status:"terminated"

rules.name: Session Cookie Missing Secure Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies transmitted over HTTP lacking the Secure flag
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:* AND NOT http.response.set_cookie:*secure*

rules.name: Session Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies lacking HttpOnly flag making them accessible to JavaScript
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:* AND NOT http.response.set_cookie:*httponly*

rules.name: Session Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Detects session cookies without SameSite attribute enabling CSRF attacks
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:* AND NOT http.response.set_cookie:*samesite*

rules.name: Session ID in URL Exposed to Referrer
rules.description: Detects session IDs transmitted in URL query parameters exposed via Referer header
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.query:*session* AND NOT url.query:*session_id*

rules.name: Session Timeout Too Long - Inactive Session
rules.description: Detects sessions active beyond 8 hours of inactivity indicating insufficient session timeout
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"session-renew" AND session.duration:>8h

rules.name: Session Token Predictable Pattern
rules.description: Detects session tokens following sequential or predictable patterns
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"session-create" AND session.id:*

rules.name: Session Hijacking Via Session Riding (CSRF)
rules.description: Detects potential CSRF attacks via unexpected state-changing requests without CSRF token
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:("POST" OR "PUT" OR "DELETE" OR "PATCH") AND NOT http.request.headers.csrf_token:*

rules.name: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking
rules.description: Detects WebSocket connections established without proper origin validation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.headers.upgrade:"websocket" AND NOT http.request.headers.origin:*

rules.name: Session Token Exposed in Log Files
rules.description: Detects session tokens appearing in application log files
rules.query: event.category:"application" AND message:(*session_id* OR *sess=* OR *jsessionid*) AND log.level:("INFO" OR "DEBUG" OR "ERROR")

rules.name: Session Cookie Domain Too Broad
rules.description: Detects session cookies set with overly broad domain scope
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:*domain=* AND NOT http.response.set_cookie:*domain=*.*.*

rules.name: Session Not Invalidated on Password Change
rules.description: Detects sessions continuing after password change event
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-change" AND session.id:*

rules.name: Session Replay - Request From Future Timestamp
rules.description: Detects requests with timestamps ahead of server time suggesting session replay attacks
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND event.action:"request" AND _timestamp:>now+5m

rules.name: JWT Algorithm Confusion Attack - RS256 to HS256
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens where algorithm was changed from RS256 to HS256 enabling algorithm confusion attacks
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.algorithm:"HS256"

rules.name: JWT None Algorithm Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens using 'none' algorithm to bypass signature verification
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.algorithm:("none" OR "None" OR "NONE")

rules.name: JWT Key ID Injection
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with suspicious kid header values that could enable SQL injection or path traversal
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.kid:(*"'"* OR *"../"* OR *"$"* OR *"{"*)

rules.name: JWT Signature Bypass - Empty Signature
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with empty or missing signature segment
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.signature:("" OR NOT _exists_)

rules.name: JWT Token Excessive Lifetime
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with expiration time exceeding 24 hours
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.expiration:>now+24h

rules.name: JWT Claim Manipulation - Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with modified role or privilege claims compared to issued values
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.claims.role:("admin" OR "superuser" OR "root")

rules.name: JWT JWK Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens containing embedded JWK (jwk header) which could enable key confusion
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.jwk:*

rules.name: JWT x5c Header Injection
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with x5c (X.509 certificate chain) header that could enable certificate spoofing
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.x5c:*

rules.name: JWT Token Replay - Simultaneous Use
rules.description: Detects same JWT token jti (JWT ID) used from different source IPs
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.jti:*

rules.name: JWT Not Before Claim in Future
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with nbf (not before) claim set in the future suggesting token manipulation
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.nbf:>now

rules.name: JWT Weak Key Detection
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens signed with weak keys identifiable by short signature length
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.algorithm:"HS256" AND jwt.signature_length:<32

rules.name: JWT Issuer Mismatch
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with issuer claim not matching expected issuer for the service
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND NOT jwt.iss:*authorized-issuer*

rules.name: JWT Audience Mismatch
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with audience claim targeting a different service than the one processing it
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.aud:* AND NOT jwt.aud:*current-service*

rules.name: JWT Token Without Required Claims
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens missing essential claims (iss, sub, aud, exp, iat)
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND (NOT _exists_:jwt.iss OR NOT _exists_:jwt.sub OR NOT _exists_:jwt.exp)

rules.name: JWT Encrypted Token With Weak Algorithm
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens encrypted with weak algorithms (dir, A128CBC-HS256) for JWE
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *" AND jwt.enc:("A128CBC-HS256" OR "A128GCM")

rules.name: OAuth Authorization Code Theft - Redirect URI Manipulation
rules.description: Detects OAuth authorization requests with modified or unexpected redirect_uri parameters
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/authorize" OR "/auth") AND url.query:*redirect_uri* AND NOT url.query:*allowed-redirect*

rules.name: OAuth Token Theft - Excessive Token Requests
rules.description: Detects unusually high volume of OAuth token requests suggesting token theft or abuse
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/oauth/token" OR "/oauth2/token") AND http.request.method:"POST"

rules.name: OAuth Scope Escalation
rules.description: Detects OAuth token requests with broader scopes than originally authorized
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/oauth/token" OR "/oauth2/token") AND oauth.scope:*

rules.name: OAuth Client Credential Abuse
rules.description: Detects OAuth client_credentials grant used for user-level operations
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND oauth.grant_type:"client_credentials" AND url.path:("/api/v*/users/*" OR "/api/v*/admin/*")

rules.name: OpenID Connect ID Token Replay
rules.description: Detects replay of OpenID Connect ID tokens across different sessions
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND oidc.id_token:* AND event.action:"token-validate"

rules.name: OAuth Implicit Grant Token Exposure
rules.description: Detects OAuth implicit grant flow returning tokens in URL fragment exposing them to theft
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/authorize" OR "/auth") AND url.query:*response_type=token*

rules.name: OAuth PKCE Downgrade Attack
rules.description: Detects OAuth authorization code flow without PKCE challenge suggesting PKCE bypass
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/authorize") AND NOT url.query:*code_challenge*

rules.name: OAuth Refresh Token Rotation Failure
rules.description: Detects OAuth refresh tokens that are not rotated on use indicating insecure implementation
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"refresh-token" AND oauth.refresh_token_reused:true

rules.name: OAuth State Parameter Missing or Reused
rules.description: Detects OAuth flows missing or reusing the state parameter enabling CSRF
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/authorize" OR "/auth") AND (NOT url.query:*state* OR oauth.state_reused:true)

rules.name: OAuth Token Stored in Local Storage
rules.description: Detects JavaScript access to OAuth tokens stored in browser local storage via XSS-prone patterns
rules.query: event.category:"application" AND message:(*localStorage.setItem*token* OR *sessionStorage.setItem*token*)

rules.name: OAuth Confidential Client Secret Exposure
rules.description: Detects OAuth client secrets transmitted in frontend code or URLs
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (url.query:*client_secret* OR http.request.body:*client_secret*) AND NOT source.ip:*backend*

rules.name: OAuth Authorization Server Impersonation
rules.description: Detects requests to fake OAuth authorization servers or phishing OAuth endpoints
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.domain:* AND (url.domain:*login-oauth* OR url.domain:*auth-oauth* OR url.domain:*oauth-verify*) AND NOT url.domain:*known-provider*

rules.name: OAuth Token Endpoint Abuse - Excessive Failed Requests
rules.description: Detects excessive failed OAuth token endpoint requests suggesting brute force or token abuse
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND url.path:("/oauth/token" OR "/oauth2/token") AND event.outcome:"failure"

rules.name: OAuth Resource Owner Password Credentials Grant
rules.description: Detects use of ROPC grant which transmits user credentials directly to the client
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND oauth.grant_type:"password"

rules.name: OAuth Token Revocation Bypass
rules.description: Detects use of OAuth tokens after revocation events indicating revocation bypass
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"token-revoked" AND oauth.token_id:*

rules.name: Privilege Escalation - Role Change Without Approval
rules.description: Detects user role elevation without corresponding approval workflow
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("role-change" OR "role-assign" OR "permission-grant") AND NOT event.action:*approval*

rules.name: Horizontal Privilege Escalation - Account Switching
rules.description: Detects users accessing other user accounts without proper authorization
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"account-switch" AND NOT event.action:*admin-impersonate*

rules.name: Vertical Privilege Escalation - Admin Function Access
rules.description: Detects non-admin users accessing admin-only endpoints or functions
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/admin"* OR *"/administrator"* OR *"/manage"* OR *"/console"*) AND user.role:("user" OR "member" OR "viewer")

rules.name: API Parameter Tampering - Role Manipulation
rules.description: Detects modification of role or permission parameters in API requests
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:("PUT" OR "PATCH" OR "POST") AND (url.query:*role* OR http.request.body:*role*) AND NOT user.role:("admin" OR "superuser")

rules.name: Mass Assignment Vulnerability - Sensitive Field Update
rules.description: Detects API requests that attempt to modify sensitive fields like role, isAdmin, or permissions
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:("PUT" OR "PATCH" OR "POST") AND http.request.body:(*"isAdmin"* OR *"role":* OR *"permissions"* OR *"userType"*)

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Direct Object Reference
rules.description: Detects access to resources by ID without proper authorization checks
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"GET" AND url.path:(*"/users/"* OR *"/accounts/"* OR *"/profiles/"*) AND NOT user.role:("admin")

rules.name: Privilege Escalation - Sudo Abuse
rules.description: Detects suspicious sudo command executions that could lead to privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"process" AND process.name:"sudo" AND NOT process.command_line:(*allowed-command*)

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via SUID Binary
rules.description: Detects execution of SUID binaries commonly exploited for privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"process" AND process.name:("nmap" OR "vim" OR "find" OR "bash" OR "python" OR "perl" OR "less" OR "more" OR "awk" OR "env") AND process.euid:0 AND process.uid:!=0

rules.name: Privilege Escalation - Container Breakout via Docker Socket
rules.description: Detects access to Docker socket enabling container breakout and host privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"process" AND process.command_line:(*"/var/run/docker.sock"* OR *"docker.sock"*)

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Kubernetes RBAC Abuse
rules.description: Detects Kubernetes RBAC privilege escalation through role binding creation or modification
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND kubernetes.audit.objectRef.resource:("rolebindings" OR "clusterrolebindings") AND kubernetes.audit.verb:("create" OR "update" OR "patch")

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Cloud IAM Policy Modification
rules.description: Detects cloud IAM policy changes that could grant elevated permissions
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:("put-policy" OR "attach-policy" OR "update-policy") AND cloud.provider:("aws" OR "azure" OR "gcp")

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Service Account Token
rules.description: Detects use of service account tokens for privilege escalation in cloud environments
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND user.type:"service-account" AND event.action:"assume-role" AND NOT user.name:*expected-service*

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Cron Job Manipulation
rules.description: Detects creation or modification of cron jobs by non-root users for privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"file" AND file.path:(*"/etc/cron.d"* OR *"/etc/crontab"* OR *"/var/spool/cron"*) AND process.name:("crontab" OR "echo" OR "tee") AND NOT user.name:"root"

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via DLL/SO Injection
rules.description: Detects suspicious DLL or shared library loading that could enable privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"process" AND (process.name:("rundll32" OR "regsvr32") OR process.env:*LD_PRELOAD*) AND NOT process.command_line:*known-good*

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Setuid/Setgid Misconfiguration
rules.description: Detects setuid or setgid bit changes on files enabling privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:"file" AND event.action:("chmod" OR "create") AND file.mode:(*"4"* OR *"2"*) AND file.path:(*"/bin"* OR *"/sbin"* OR *"/usr/bin"*)

rules.name: IDOR - Sequential ID Access Pattern
rules.description: Detects sequential resource ID access patterns indicating IDOR enumeration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"GET" AND url.path:(*"/users/"* OR *"/accounts/"* OR *"/orders/"*) AND NOT user.role:("admin")

rules.name: IDOR - UUID Guessing Through Observable Patterns
rules.description: Detects access to resources using predictable UUIDs or IDs across multiple requests
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"GET" AND url.path:(*"/api/v*/"*) AND user.role:("user" OR "member") AND event.outcome:"success"

rules.name: IDOR - Cross-Tenant Data Access
rules.description: Detects users accessing data belonging to different tenants in multi-tenant applications
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"GET" AND url.path:*tenant* AND NOT user.tenant:*url.tenant*

rules.name: IDOR - Parameter Manipulation in POST Requests
rules.description: Detects POST requests with manipulated object IDs in request body enabling unauthorized writes
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"POST" AND (http.request.body:*user_id* OR http.request.body:*account_id* OR http.request.body:*owner_id*) AND NOT user.role:("admin")

rules.name: IDOR - Access to Deleted or Inactive Resources
rules.description: Detects access to deleted or inactive user resources suggesting IDOR
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.status_code:404 AND url.path:(*"/users/"* OR *"/accounts/"*) AND http.request.method:"GET"

rules.name: IDOR - Admin API Endpoint Access by Regular User
rules.description: Detects regular users accessing admin API endpoints through direct URL manipulation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/admin/"* OR *"/manage/"* OR *"/internal/"*) AND user.role:("user" OR "member" OR "viewer")

rules.name: IDOR - Bulk Data Export by Non-Admin User
rules.description: Detects non-admin users exporting or downloading large volumes of data
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"GET" AND url.path:(*"/export"* OR *"/download"* OR *"/report"*) AND user.role:("user" OR "member") AND http.response.body.bytes:>1000000

rules.name: IDOR - File Access Without Ownership Check
rules.description: Detects file access requests lacking proper ownership verification
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"/files/"* OR *"/documents/"* OR *"/attachments/"*) AND NOT http.request.headers.authorization:*owner*

rules.name: IDOR - GraphQL Depth Abuse for Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects GraphQL queries with excessive depth enabling unauthorized data traversal
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:*"/graphql"* AND graphql.depth:>5

rules.name: IDOR - REST API Path Traversal to Other Users
rules.description: Detects path traversal patterns in REST API requests enabling access to other users' data
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.path:(*"../"* OR *"..%2F"* OR *"%2e%2e"* OR *"..%252f"*) AND http.request.method:("GET" OR "PUT" OR "DELETE")

rules.name: API Key Exposure in URL Query Parameters
rules.description: Detects API keys transmitted in URL query parameters visible in logs and browser history
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.query:(*"api_key="* OR *"apikey="* OR *"access_token="* OR *"secret_key="*)

rules.name: API Key Exposure in HTTP Referrer Header
rules.description: Detects API keys or tokens leaked via HTTP Referer header to external domains
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.headers.referer:(*"api_key="* OR *"token="* OR *"secret="*)

rules.name: Hardcoded API Key in Application Source Code
rules.description: Detects hardcoded API keys found in application error messages or logs
rules.query: event.category:"application" AND message:(*"AKIA"* OR *"sk_live"* OR *"pk_live"* OR *"ghp_"* OR *"glpat-"*)

rules.name: Token Theft - Bearer Token in Non-HTTPS Request
rules.description: Detects bearer tokens transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND url.scheme:"http" AND http.request.headers.authorization:"Bearer *"

rules.name: Refresh Token Theft - Token Used From Anomalous Location
rules.description: Detects refresh tokens used from IP addresses geographically distant from original authentication
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"refresh-token" AND source.geo.country_name:* AND NOT source.geo.country_name:*expected*

rules.name: API Key Usage From Multiple Locations Simultaneously
rules.description: Detects same API key used from geographically distinct locations indicating key theft
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"api-key-auth" AND api.key_id:*

rules.name: Access Token Excessive Scope Usage
rules.description: Detects access tokens used for operations beyond their authorized scope
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"token-auth" AND oauth.scope:* AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT oauth.scope:*expected*

rules.name: Stale API Key Used After Rotation Policy
rules.description: Detects API keys used beyond their rotation policy timeframe
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"api-key-auth" AND api.key_age:>90d

rules.name: Token Replay - Same Token From Different User Agents
rules.description: Detects same authentication token used with different user agents suggesting token theft
rules.query: event.category:"authentication" AND event.action:"token-auth" AND session.id:* AND http.user_agent:*

rules.name: API Key Exposure in Error Messages
rules.description: Detects API keys or secrets exposed in application error messages or stack traces
rules.query: event.category:"application" AND (http.response.status_code:(500 OR 502 OR 503) AND message:(*"key"* OR *"secret"* OR *"token"* OR *"password"*))

rules.name: CORS Wildcard Origin Configuration
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses with Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to wildcard
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_origin:"*"

rules.name: CORS Reflected Origin - Dynamic Allow Origin
rules.description: Detects CORS configurations that reflect the request Origin header in Access-Control-Allow-Origin
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_origin:* AND http.request.headers.origin:* AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_origin:http.request.headers.origin

rules.name: CORS Allow Credentials With Wildcard Origin
rules.description: Detects CORS responses allowing credentials with wildcard origin which is a critical misconfiguration
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_origin:"*" AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_credentials:"true"

rules.name: CORS Null Origin Allowed
rules.description: Detects CORS responses allowing null origin which can be exploited via sandboxed iframes
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.headers.access_control_allow_origin:"null"

rules.name: CSRF Attack - Missing Anti-CSRF Token on State-Changing Request
rules.description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH requests without anti-CSRF tokens
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:("POST" OR "PUT" OR "DELETE" OR "PATCH") AND NOT http.request.headers:(*csrf* OR *x-csrf* OR *xsrf*)

rules.name: CSRF via JSON Content-Type Bypass
rules.description: Detects state-changing requests using JSON content type to bypass CSRF token validation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.method:"POST" AND http.request.headers.content_type:"application/json" AND NOT http.request.headers:(*csrf* OR *x-csrf*)

rules.name: CSRF Attack via Multipart Form Upload
rules.description: Detects multipart form uploads without CSRF protection enabling cross-site file uploads
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.headers.content_type:"multipart/form-data" AND NOT http.request.headers:(*csrf* OR *x-csrf*)

rules.name: Session Cookie Path Too Broad
rules.description: Detects session cookies with path=/ set too broadly increasing exposure risk
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:*"path=/"* AND NOT http.response.set_cookie:*"path=/specific"

rules.name: Session Cookie With Excessive Expiration
rules.description: Detects session cookies with expiration exceeding session policy limits
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.response.set_cookie:*"max-age"* AND http.response.set_cookie.cookie_max_age:>86400

rules.name: Sensitive Data in Cookie Without Encryption
rules.description: Detects sensitive data (PII, credentials) stored in unencrypted cookie values
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND http.request.cookies:(*"email="* OR *"ssn="* OR *"password="* OR *"credit_card="*) AND url.scheme:"http"

rules.name: Password Policy Violation - Weak Password Accepted
rules.description: Detects successful password changes to passwords that don't meet minimum complexity requirements
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-change" AND event.outcome:"success" AND NOT password.complexity:*meets-policy*

rules.name: Password Reuse Detection
rules.description: Detects password changes to passwords matching previously compromised passwords
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-change" AND password.in_breach_database:true

rules.name: Password Reset Abuse - No Identity Verification
rules.description: Detects password reset requests without proper identity verification steps
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-reset" AND NOT event.action:*mfa-verify* AND NOT event.action:*email-verify*

rules.name: Password Change Rate Limiting Bypass
rules.description: Detects rapid successive password changes suggesting brute force or lockout bypass
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-change"

rules.name: Account Enumeration via Password Reset
rules.description: Detects password reset responses that reveal whether an account exists enabling user enumeration
rules.query: event.category:"iam" AND event.action:"password-reset" AND http.response.body:(*"account not found"* OR *"user does not exist"* OR *"invalid email"*)
